summary: Draws a button in the Inspector that calls a parameterless method.
overview: Put it above a parameterless method and a button appears in the Inspector that calls it — for Regenerate, Test or Reset actions, without writing a custom Editor. The drawer that renders it lives in an Editor folder, which is why the attribute and its drawer are two files.
useCases: A Regenerate button on a procedural component.
Triggering a debug action without entering Play mode.
Testing a method without a temporary test script.

gotchas.title: Parameterless methods only
gotchas.body: There is nowhere to enter arguments. A method needing input needs a proper custom editor.

gotchas.title: Changes made by the method need marking dirty
gotchas.body: Editing a serialized value from the button will not persist unless the method marks the object dirty itself.
